purpose: Provide a bounded, hash-verifiable handoff for future user-supplied DFPI and Vietnamese official-reference artifacts without authorizing scraping, candidate enumeration, labels, or model use.

instructions: Use a normal browser session or a first-party download/export offered by DFPI; do not bypass access controls.
Save the original artifact unchanged and record one manifest item for each file.
Treat each complaint-derived record as a case seed with UNCERTAIN status until independent official corroboration and exact observed-artifact linkage are reviewed.
Do not acquire records until an explicit official export/download basis or written internal academic reuse permission has been retained.
After that prerequisite is independently verified, preserve only the authorized original artifact and minimal provenance; do not redistribute complete page bundles.
An SSC warning is evidence and a case seed, not an automatic CONFIRMED label or model feature.
Do not acquire records until an explicit official export/download basis or written internal academic reuse permission has been retained.
After that prerequisite is independently verified, retain only authorized original artifacts and minimal issuer/domain provenance; do not republish HNX page or data bundles.
An HNX listing supports identity reconciliation only and is not an automatic LEGITIMATE label or safety guarantee.

accepted_for_qa_only_when: the source ID, official URL host, acquisition mode, and rights-basis type satisfy the source-specific contract
the immutable file exists under the exact source directory and its byte size and SHA-256 match the manifest
acquisition time, original filename, media type, rights note, and personal-data flag are present
written permission or export-terms evidence is locally retained when required

after_intake_sequence: independently verify bytes, hashes, source identity, rights basis, and personal-data handling
register an immutable intake result without copying protected source content into Git
if a Vietnamese channel is adopted, freeze and verify Sampling Matrix V2 before candidate enumeration
create a separate hash-bound acquisition or enumeration release
later capture a distinct archived observed investment artifact; official reference prose is never the model input
perform grouping, primary review, blind second review, reconciliation, and owner acceptance

decision.next_gate: Receive a user-supplied DFPI first-party artifact or explicit official export, or retain and independently verify an explicit export/reuse basis before any SSC/HNX acquisition.
